release_readiness_implication: Use OSDR source identifiers, metadata, and access boundaries as primary public-source anchors.
topic: OSDR repository scope and curated metadata

release_readiness_implication: Public cards and release notes should credit OSDR/GeneLab explicitly and keep public and controlled data separated.
A release needs findable identifiers, access metadata, interoperable schemas, and reuse constraints beyond local files.
Future packaging should connect data entities, scripts, workflow runs, provenance, authorship, licensing, and outputs.
Versioned public releases should expose creators, title, version, identifiers, related identifiers, and resource type.
A public dataset artifact should include a rendered README/card with scope, structure, intended use, limitations, and metadata.
A release candidate should plan a versioned archive path if it will be cited as a stable public artifact.
